name: When should I hire a general contractor for rental property interior repairs instead of a handyman?

mainEntity.name: When should I hire a general contractor for rental property interior repairs instead of a handyman?

acceptedAnswer.text: A general contractor is best suited for larger projects that involve multiple trades, significant structural changes, or require permits and inspections. Examples include extensive renovations, remodeling bathrooms or kitchens, or repairing significant water damage. A handyman is ideal for smaller, isolated tasks like fixing a leaky faucet, patching drywall, or painting a single room. For comprehensive repairs involving coordination and oversight, a general contractor offers a unified approach.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hire a general contractor for large projects involving multiple trades, permits, or significant structural work, such as renovations. Use a handyman for smaller, isolated tasks like patching drywall or minor plumbing fixes.
